test_title: PYST 27: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Toshi starts from point A and drives 70 km towards east. He then takes a left turn, drives 45 km, turns left and drives 78 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 76 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 8 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
According to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e9852490b76888b0d169666ac11bcabb2f96df2fb4ea7a275763605f66a69cf.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/200f8ab7f12e7f46d5aafc9ec4fbdec5b3c611bae8693a15c406ad23418badfa.png] 

To reach point A again, he should drive 76 - 45 = 31 km towards North direction.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 3”.
